payload.title: Agent definitions, the catalog and generated runbooks
payload.description:
One way to set up an agent: a definition file in Git that fills the 11-point template, validated and applied by the release. Done when every agent on every site comes from a definition file, the inventory page and each runbook are generated from the definitions, and every agent loads the standard context pack plus the site's add-only instructions.

**Design:** `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md`. Companion: `docs/design/announcement-delivery-design.md`.

**Acceptance for the epic:** every child is closed with its acceptance criteria met; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; nothing created by hand in AWS.
